exposure: Fetuses dropping by >=50 estimated fetal weight (EFW) centiles between the second and third trimester (decelerating growth)
Nondecelerating appropriate for gestational age (AGA) fetuses
cohort: The study included 4394 singleton pregnancies progressing after 32 + 0 weeks gestation, who had their second- and third-trimester scans at the study institutions.
finding: Compared to nondecelerating SGA fetuses, AGA fetuses that crossed >=50 EFW centiles between the second and third trimester had significantly higher rates of NICU admission (OR 1.8, 95% CI 1.1-3.1) and perinatal death (OR 3.8, 95% CI 1.3-11.4).
gest_age: Pregnancies progressing after 32+0 weeks; gestational age at birth was a predictor.
